basic_info.description: Beautifully updated and fully detached, this Westwood Park home offers 2,604 square feet of flexible living space. The main level features coved ceilings, refinished hardwood floors, a bright living room with tiled fireplace, and formal dining room. The remodeled kitchen includes sleek cabinetry, quartz countertops, mosaic backsplash, and premium stainless steel appliances. Windows throughout fill the home with abundant natural light. Upstairs offers 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, including a spacious primary suite with ensuite bath and walk-in closet. Downstairs includes a large great room, perfect for a home theater, plus a half bath and laundry room. Completing the bottom floor are 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, and an additional generous living area. The downstairs has its own separate entrances via the garage and side of the home, perfect for extended family or rental income. Additional highlights include modern finishes, a spacious backyard, long driveway, and 1-car garage. Close to Ocean Ave, Resturants, BART, freeway access, and Stonestown Galleria.
